decision.reason: [ev-5b5fdbd0eddf] is a one-line highlight saying that object-level workload identity authentication was added for `Bucket` and `Provider`, so the change type "added" is plausible. The subject is not settled. The text never names the field, key or setting that carries the feature, and it covers two different kinds. Calling it a protocol-behavior (wire behaviour such as TLS or ALPN) is a guess, when the feature is configured per object on two resources. The rest of the highlights section (e.g. [ev-18f64e30ab1c]) does not settle it either; to type the subject we need the release or upgrade-guide text that names the field on Bucket and Provider (for example, its API group and path).
